children: GeoVax provided a Nasdaq listing update and reaffirmed focus on advancing GEO-MVA toward a planned pivotal Phase 3 while pursuing partnerships and funding.
GeoVax requested a Nasdaq hearing to appeal an August 27, 2026 delisting notice for minimum bid price noncompliance.
The Nasdaq hearing is scheduled for October 13, 2026; the hearing request stays any suspension or delisting action pending the outcome.
Company expects its common stock to continue trading on Nasdaq under GOVX at least through the hearing and any Panel extension.
GeoVax will present a plan at the hearing to regain and maintain compliance while continuing execution of strategic priorities.
Priority program GEO-MVA is advancing under an expedited pathway with plans for a pivotal Phase 3 to address orthopoxvirus vaccine supply and biodefense preparedness.

title: GeoVax provides Nasdaq hearing update, plans to present compliance plan and advance GEO-MVA Phase 3
